gold: Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) with Giant R-wave Syndrome

selector.rationale: Decisive findings of diffuse stenosis in proximal to mid-LAD and 80% stenosis in mid-right coronary artery support Coronary Artery Disease, while polymorphic ventricular tachycardia and QTc of 403 milliseconds also suggest arrhythmic conditions but are not exclusive to other options

rejected.label: Ischemic Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Normal left ventricular ejection fraction of 58% does not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Long QT Syndrome
rejected.why: QTc of 403 milliseconds is not significantly prolonged to solely support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Normal transthoracic echocardiography results do not indicate hypertrophy
